text:
Sophia (PM): Quick sync — goal is to get the seller playbook + PLG experiment ready for a soft launch by EOW. Who has blockers?
Jared (Sales): Target accounts are prepped. Main blocker = final playbook + objection handling doc. I can draft objections if I get value props from PM. ETA Tue.
Mira (Marketing): Landing page + nurture stream are in progress. Need 3 value props (short, punchy) and hero CTA. Also want one-liner for the sellers cheat sheet.
Sophia (PM): Got it. Pushing three value props now. Launch criteria I want us explicit about — copying checklist:
```
- Product: activation event `user_activated` logged in prod
- Enablement: 1-pager + 30-min seller deck ready
- Sales: at least 3 pilot commitments signed
- Metrics: activation rate >= 3% in pilot cohort
- Risk: fallback model for high latency in place
```
If any of these can't be met, call it out and we'll scope down.
Tess (AE): Running 3 pilots this week. Need pricing matrix + FAQ. Also can take seller cheat sheet and localize for EMEA.
Ezra (Growth): For the PLG experiment we plan in-app prompt + 14-day trial credits. Need product telemetry hook to capture activation and trial-to-paid funnel. Engineering: can we expose `user_activated` + `trial_started` events?
ReleaseBot: Release scheduled to staging: 1795090000; owner: release-engineering.
Jared (Sales): I'll assemble a kickoff doc for sellers with cold/warmer scripts. Marketing — can you turn the one-pager into a single-slide cheat sheet?
Mira (Marketing): :thumbsup: Yes, I can do a cheat sheet + 2 A/B copy variants. Delivering Wed morning.
Tess (AE): One more ask — set rollout pass/fail: if pilot NPS < 7 or activation < 2% after 7 days, hold. Does everyone agree?
Sophia (PM): Agree on NPS/activation thresholds. If telemetry isn't available by Thu noon, plan B is to run limited live sessions and capture manual feedback.
Ezra (Growth): I'll wire the experiment dashboard and map events. If product can't add `trial_started`, we can infer from billing API but that delays metrics.
Sophia (PM): OK — owners: Product (Sophia) for value props + fallback plan, Marketing (Mira) for cheat sheet + LP copy, Sales (Jared/Tess) for pilot signups + kickoff doc, Growth (Ezra) for dashboard. Everyone, post any blockers by EOD today. If none, soft launch Fri EOD. :rocket:
